SZ.dated: VAT Act 2011 with the VAT (Rates) Regulations (LN 52 of 2012 as amended by LN 112 of 2018) and LN 130 of 2025; ERS guide pages (live 2026-11-21) for the company rate and withholding taxes
SZ.sources_add: Fetched from ers.org.sz (`cmp20/global/R4/fetch/sz8/`, SHA256SUMS): VAT Act 2011, VAT Regulations, VAT (Rates) (Amendment) Regulations 2018 (OCR), VAT (Amendment) Act 2022 (OCR), LN 130 of 2025 (OCR), ERS pages 'Rates and thresholds', 'Withholding', 'VAT'.

vat.name: Value Added Tax
vat.statute: Value Added Tax Act 2011 s. 24 (3) (rate set by the VAT Regulations); VAT (Rates) Regulations (LN 52 of 2012) reg. 3 (1) as replaced by the VAT (Rates) (Amendment) Regulations 2018 (LN 112 of 2018, from 1 August 2018): 15 %; First Schedule (exempt), Second Schedule (zero-rated)
vat.doc: VAT Act 2011 s. 24 (3): "Subject to subsection (4), the rate of tax shall be as specified in the VAT Regulations"; (4): zero-rated supplies are those of the Second Schedule. LN 112 of 2018 reg. 2: "Legal Notice No. 52 of 2012 is amended in regulation 3 by deleting sub-regulation (1) and replacing it with ... (1) The rate of Value Added Tax shall be fifteen percent (15%)"; in force 1 August 2018. ERS 'VAT' page (2026): "levied on most goods and services at the rate of 15%". First Schedule 1: exempt "(b) the supply of financial services; (c) the supply of insurance services; ... (f) the supply of education services; (g) the supply of medical, dental, and nursing services; ... (m) the supply of passenger transportation services, other than services ...; (n) the supply of tap water and sewage"; Second Schedule 1 (p): zero-rated "the supply of prescription drugs and medicines". LN 130 of 2025 (17 Dec 2025) restates tap water as exempt (Part B clause 1(1)(l)).
notes: the schedules were restructured into Parts A (services) and B (goods) by the VAT (Amendment) Act 2022 and LN 270 of 2022 (the schedule notice is not held: the ERS link answers 404); the 2011 schedule items are applied

Second Schedule basic foods (maize meal, maize, beans, milk, brown bread, fresh fruit and vegetables, eggs, vegetable oil) are zero-rated: the basket food line is processed food (region convention), so not applied
residential lettings exempt (First Schedule 1 (e)) not separable

cit.name: Corporate income tax
cit.statute: Income Tax Order 1975 (company rate 27,5 % since 1 July 2013), per the Eswatini Revenue Service guide (official secondary)
cit.doc: ERS 'Rates and thresholds' (live 2026-11-21): "TAX RATE FOR COMPANIES The effective tax rate for companies (since the 1st July 2013) is 27.5% of taxable income." The Income Tax Order 1975 held prints only individual tables; the Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2023 (scanned) was not read. Grade B.
notes: the guide's sentence is undated beyond 'since 1 July 2013'; no later change found on the ERS pages

wht.name: Withholding on payments to non-residents
wht.statute: Income Tax Order 1975 (non-resident withholding taxes), per the ERS 'Withholding' guide (official secondary): royalties and management fees 15 %, services contracts 15 %, interest 10 %
wht.doc: ERS 'Withholding' (live 2026-11-21): "Every person who makes any payment of royalty or management fee or both to a person not ordinarily resident in Swaziland is required to withhold tax. The rate of tax is fifteen percent of the gross amount of any management charge. The tax is final"; "The non-resident person is liable to withholding tax at the rate of fifteen percent on the gross amount of any payment derived by the non-resident under a Swaziland source services contract"; "The debtor ... shall withhold and remit to ERS tax equal to ten per cent of the interest that accrues to or in favour of the non-resident."

rules.statute: ITO 1975 (ERS guide): management fees and services contracts 15 %

notes: non-resident shareholders tax on dividends: the guide's rate table is garbled (SACU / outside SACU rows) and the prose gives no rate: not applied
